```{r setup, include=FALSE} 
knitr::opts_chunk$set(warning = FALSE, message = FALSE) 
```

```{r}
library(tidyverse)
library(terra)
library(tmap)
library(here)
library(sf)
```

## Prepare the data

```{r}
eez <- st_read('data/wc_regions') # West Coast Economic zones

bathy <- rast('data/depth.tif') # Depth Raster

sst2008 <- rast('data/average_annual_sst_2008.tif')
sst2009 <- rast('data/average_annual_sst_2009.tif')
sst2010 <- rast('data/average_annual_sst_2010.tif')
sst2011 <- rast('data/average_annual_sst_2011.tif')
sst2012 <- rast('data/average_annual_sst_2012.tif')

sst <- c(sst2008, sst2009, sst2010, sst2011, sst2012) # Surface Temperatures for each year 2008-2012
```


## Process the data

Average the SST across 2008-2012 and convert to Celsius

```{r}
sstmean <- mean(sst, na.rm = TRUE) - 273.15 
```

Crop extent of depth raster to match that of SST raster

```{r}
bathycrop <- crop(bathy,ext(sstmean))
```

Resample the depth data to match the resolution of the SST data using the bilinear method approach

```{r}
bathy_resample <- resample(bathycrop, sstmean, method = 'bilinear')
```

Make CRSs match

```{r}
bathy_resample <- project(bathy_resample,crs(sstmean))
eez <- st_transform(eez, crs(sstmean))

crs(bathy_resample) == crs(sstmean)
st_crs(bathy_resample) == st_crs(eez)
```


## Determine the most suitable EEZ

select suitable cells within West Coast EEZ

```{r}
can_we_grow_this_fish <- function(tempmin, tempmax, depthmin, depthmax, species = 'species') {

    # Subset map for temperature
    temp <- sstmean
    temp[temp < tempmin | temp > tempmax] <- NA
    temp[not.na(temp)] <- 1

    # Subset map for depth
    depth <- bathy_resample
    depth[depth < depthmax | depth > depthmin] <- NA
    depth[not.na(depth)] <- 1

    # Combine rasters
    place <- temp * depth

    # Find area of suitable area by EEZ
    byeez <- function(x) {
    poly <- as.polygons(mask(place,eez[x,])) |> 
        st_as_sf()
    st_area(poly[1,])
    }

    # Farmable area by EEZ 
    suitarea <- eez |> 
    mutate(suitable_area = c(byeez(1), byeez(2), byeez(3), byeez(4), byeez(5))) |> 
    mutate(suitable_area = as.numeric(suitable_area/ 1000000))

    # Map
    tm_shape(suitarea) +
        tm_polygons(fill ='suitable_area',
            fill.scale = tm_scale_categorical(values = 'tableau.classic_blue'),
            fill.legend = tm_legend(position = tm_pos_in('left','bottom'),
            title = 'Suitable Area km2')) +
        tm_basemap('OpenStreetMap.DE') +
        tm_title(paste(species,'Aquaculture Area by West Coast EEZ')) +
        tm_compass(position = tm_pos_in('left','top')) +
        tm_scalebar(position = tm_pos_in('center','bottom'))
}
```

```{r}
#| fig-width: 10
#| fig-height: 7
# Running the function for Oysters
can_we_grow_this_fish(11, 30, 0, -70, species = 'Oyster')
```

```{r}
#| fig-width: 10
#| fig-height: 7
# Running the function for Pacific Geoduck
can_we_grow_this_fish(8.5, 17.3, 0, -110, species = 'Pacific Geoduck')
```
